common.notAvailable: The Attendance module is not on for this shop. Contact AnyRent to turn it on.
common.noAccess: Only the shop owner and outlet admins use this screen.

timesheet.title: Timesheet · Month {month}
timesheet.subtitle: {count} staff · {lock}
timesheet.empty: No staff or attendance at this outlet this month.

legend.hint: Click a name → the whole month · click a cell → that day

export.title: Export timesheet to Excel
export.grid: Month grid (hours per day, total hours, days)
export.failed: Could not export the Excel file.

lock.title: Lock month {month}?
lock.body: Once locked, outlet admins can no longer edit this month. Only the shop owner can unlock it (logged). The Payroll module will use locked months later.
lock.unlockBody: After unlocking, this month can be edited again. The change is logged.

edit.title: Edit attendance · {name} · {date}
edit.noOut: no clock-out (closed at the end of the day)
edit.reasonPlaceholder: Forgot to clock out, confirmed by the manager
edit.note: History is kept: who edited, what, and when. A locked month cannot be edited.

add.title: Add attendance record · {name}
add.sub: For when the staff member worked but could not scan.

map.title: Scan location · {name} · {when}
map.label: Map of the scan location and the attendance area

shifts.title: Shifts
shifts.subtitle: Week {from} – {to} · today {today}
shifts.legendLock: 🔒 started shift / past day: cannot edit
shifts.rulesHint: Edit / stop / delete only change days not yet worked

day.lockedBody: 🔒 This shift has started or the day is past, so it cannot be changed. To fix worked hours, use the Timesheet.
day.note: Changes this day only. Later weeks keep the weekly schedule. The app notifies {name}.

assign.title: Assign shift (weekly)
assign.sub: Assign once; it repeats every week until changed.
assign.keep: Worked days and one-day changes stay as they are.
assign.noTemplates: No shift templates yet. Create one in the Shift templates tab first.

ruleEdit.title: Edit weekly schedule · {name}
ruleEdit.note: Worked or past days stay as they are.

ruleStop.title: Stop weekly schedule · {name}
ruleStop.note: From {next}, {name} no longer has the {shift} shift. Use it when someone leaves or changes schedule.

ruleDelete.title: Delete weekly schedule · {name}?
ruleDelete.note: Days not yet worked lose the {shift} shift. Worked days stay in the timesheet.

templates.title: Shift templates
templates.subtitle: {outlet} · used when assigning shifts
templates.hint: A used template can only be hidden (history is kept); an unused one can be deleted. Time changes only apply to days not yet worked.

templateForm.name: Shift name
templateForm.overnight: An end before the start (e.g. 22:00–02:00) is an overnight shift, counted on the start day.
templateForm.editNote: Time changes only apply to days not yet worked; past days keep the old hours.

templateHide.title: Hide template "{name}"?
templateHide.sub: This shift has been used, so it cannot be deleted.
templateHide.note: Hidden: it can no longer be picked when assigning. Weekly schedules using it keep running; worked days stay as they are.

templateDelete.title: Delete template "{name}"?
templateDelete.sub: This shift has never been used.

outlet.picking: Click the map to set the outlet location.
outlet.geoFailed: Could not get the current location. Check the browser's location permission.
outlet.ownerOnly: Only the shop owner changes the location and radius.
outlet.radiusHint: 50–500 m. Indoor GPS is often off by 10–50 m.
outlet.checks: Checked on each scan: this outlet's code and still valid · inside the radius · GPS ≤ 100 m · fake location blocked · server time. Forgot to clock out: closed at the end of the day, 0 hours until an admin fixes it.
outlet.dailyHint: New code at 00:00 Vietnam time. Show it on the counter screen or print it each morning.
outlet.fixedHint: Print once and stick it on the wall. A photo of it keeps working; only GPS and fake-location checks protect it.
outlet.noQr: This outlet has no QR code yet.
outlet.saveNote: Applies to the next scans right away.

newCode.title: Create a new QR code?
newCode.body: The current code stops working at once. If the outlet uses a fixed code, print and stick up the new one. The counter screen updates by itself.
newCode.done: New code created; the old one no longer works

print.title: Print QR code · {name}
print.body: A5 sheet with the outlet name and the line "Open the AnyRent app → Settings → Attendance → scan the code".
print.dailyNote: Changes daily: the printout only works on {date}.
print.howTo: Open the AnyRent app → Settings → Attendance → scan the code

kioskLink.title: Counter screen link
kioskLink.none: This outlet has no counter screen link yet.
kioskLink.note: Open this link on a tablet or an old phone at the counter. No login needed and no one's account is affected. The screen changes the code at 00:00.
kioskLink.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the link and copy it.
kioskLink.created: New link created; the old link no longer works

kiosk.title: Attendance
kiosk.help: Open the AnyRent app → Settings → Attendance → scan this code
kiosk.none: No one has clocked in today.
kiosk.invalid: This counter link no longer works. Ask the shop owner for a new link.
kiosk.moduleOff: The Attendance module is not on for this shop.
kiosk.notConfigured: This outlet has no location or QR code yet.
kiosk.failed: Could not load the code. Retrying…
